name: Wyress Strigidae

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Teleport Strike
abilities.description: The enemy teleports and stabs the player. This attack does moderate physical damage and stuns the player briefly.

abilities.name: Arrow Spray
abilities.description: The enemy shoots out a spray of arrows in front of herself dealing moderate physical damage and snaring all targets hit as indicated by a red cone.

abilities.name: Owl's Silence
abilities.description: The boss is surrounded by a blue aura (see image) that silences you, preventing players from using any ability costing Health, Magicka, Ultimate or have no cost at all. When killed, she will spawn an owl that emanates the same aura. The owl cannot be damaged and will move on its own. Stand at range to avoid the silence.

abilities.name: Taking Aim
abilities.description: The boss winds up a charged shot on a random target that deals very high physical damage. This must be interrupted or dodged.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: It appears Lord Hircine has gifted us with fresh prey.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: Make sure to put up a fight. I wouldn't want to bore our Lord Hircine.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: In the Huntsman's name, I shall strike you down.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: "I've got the target in sight!" (When performing her interruptible bow attack.)

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: Lord Hircine shall be pleased by our victory.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: Hopefully our next prey will put up more of a fight.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: You're now as silent as the owl's wings.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: My spirit remains with you, sisters.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: The spirit of the owl lives on.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: I can never be truly defeated.

dialogue.speaker: Wyress Strigidae
dialogue.line: So we have become the prey ... how pathetic.

notes: She is the author of The Glory of the Hunt.
Prior to being removed from her wardrobe in live, she wore Jhunal's Owl Mask.

It was revealed that she along with her sisters each represent a different aspect of Hircine in ESO Live's preview of Wolfhunter (Timestamp 32:30). She however fits none of the aspects listed in the book Aspects of Lord Hircine.
related_quests: The Great Hunt: Conquer the March of Sacrifices and emerge victorious in the Great Hunt.
summary: Wyress Strigidae is a Redguard wyress who can be found along with her sisters, Rangifer and Ursus, in the March of Sacrifices. They amuse themselves by hunting and testing themselves against the competitors in Hircine's Great Hunt. Wyress Strigidae is armed with a bow, complementing Rangifer's magic and Ursus' mace.
